recommendations.title: Mexican Gothic
recommendations.author: Silvia Moreno-Garcia
recommendations.reason: Given their interest in atmospheric horror with literary weight—seen through choices like 'The Terror,' 'Dark Matter,' and 'The Silent Companions'—this gothic horror set in 1950s Mexico should resonate deeply.

recommendations.title: The Subterraneans
recommendations.author: Jack Kerouac
recommendations.reason: Their interest in 'On the Road' and literary fiction with philosophical undercurrents, alongside Coming of Age narratives, makes this raw, confessional Kerouac novella a natural next step.

recommendations.title: A Gentleman in Moscow
recommendations.author: Amor Towles
recommendations.reason: Their appreciation for richly detailed historical literary fiction, as shown by 'The Books of Jacob,' 'The Thousand Autumns of Jacob de Zoet,' and 'Augustus,' suggests they would love this elegant, character-driven novel set across decades of Russian history.

recommendations.title: The Raw Shark Texts
recommendations.author: Steven Hall
recommendations.reason: Their fondness for genre-bending, conceptually adventurous fiction—evidenced by 'House of Leaves,' 'How to Live Safely in a Science Fictional Universe,' and 'Little, Big'—makes this postmodern thriller about memory and identity a strong match.

recommendations.title: Butcher's Crossing
recommendations.author: John Williams
recommendations.reason: Their interest in 'Augustus' by John Williams and gritty American literary fiction from authors like Larry Brown and Cormac McCarthy makes this stark, existential Western a natural fit.

recommendations.title: The Little Stranger
recommendations.author: Sarah Waters
recommendations.reason: Their love of Sarah Waters via 'Tipping the Velvet' and 'Fingersmith,' combined with their appetite for slow-burn literary horror like 'We Have Always Lived in the Castle' and 'The Terror,' makes this haunted-house novel a perfect fit.

recommendations.title: The Moor's Account
recommendations.author: Laila Lalami
recommendations.reason: Their interest in historical fiction with rich cultural scope—evidenced by 'The Books of Jacob,' 'The Thousand Autumns of Jacob de Zoet,' and 'Undaunted Courage'—makes this Booker-longlisted novel about the first African explorer of America a compelling choice.

recommendations.title: Galveston
recommendations.author: Nic Pizzolatto
recommendations.reason: Their fondness for noir-inflected Southern literary fiction—seen through 'Bluebird, Bluebird,' 'Cottonmouths,' and 'Joe'—makes this dark, atmospheric crime novel about fate and redemption along the Gulf Coast an excellent match.

recommendations.title: The Night Country
